name: readwrite ASCII overwrite preserves the following UTF-8 bytes
command:
bug68_open_rc=
bug68_write_rc=
exec 3<> sample.bin
bug68_open_rc=$?
if [ "$bug68_open_rc" -eq 0 ]; then
  printf X >&3
  bug68_write_rc=$?
fi
printf 'open=%s\nwrite=%s\n' "$bug68_open_rc" "$bug68_write_rc"
bug68_report_rc=$?
if [ "$bug68_open_rc" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$bug68_open_rc"; fi
if [ -n "$bug68_write_rc" ] && [ "$bug68_write_rc" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$bug68_write_rc"; fi
exit "$bug68_report_rc"

name: readwrite dup shares byte position after a text read
command:
# Planned command text only. NOT_RUN; no executable driver is included.
# The parent must create ./sample.bin as exactly 41e4b8ad0a in a private cwd.

exec 3<> './sample.bin'
open_rc=$?
printf 'BUG68_STEP open_rc %s\n' "$open_rc"
report_rc=$?
if [ "$open_rc" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$open_rc"; fi
if [ "$report_rc" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$report_rc"; fi

exec 4>&3
dup_rc=$?
printf 'BUG68_STEP dup_rc %s\n' "$dup_rc"
report_rc=$?
if [ "$dup_rc" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$dup_rc"; fi
if [ "$report_rc" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$report_rc"; fi

printf X >&3
first_write_rc=$?
printf 'BUG68_STEP first_write_rc %s\n' "$first_write_rc"
report_rc=$?
if [ "$first_write_rc" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$first_write_rc"; fi
if [ "$report_rc" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$report_rc"; fi

read -r -u4 value
read_rc=$?
printf 'BUG68_STEP read_rc %s\n' "$read_rc"
report_rc=$?
if [ "$read_rc" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$read_rc"; fi
if [ "$report_rc" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$report_rc"; fi

test "$value" = '中'
value_equal_rc=$?
printf 'BUG68_STEP value_equal_rc %s\n' "$value_equal_rc"
report_rc=$?
if [ "$value_equal_rc" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$value_equal_rc"; fi
if [ "$report_rc" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$report_rc"; fi

printf Y >&3
second_write_rc=$?
printf 'BUG68_STEP second_write_rc %s\n' "$second_write_rc"
report_rc=$?
if [ "$second_write_rc" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$second_write_rc"; fi
if [ "$report_rc" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$report_rc"; fi

exit 0
stdout:
BUG68_STEP open_rc 0
BUG68_STEP dup_rc 0
BUG68_STEP first_write_rc 0
BUG68_STEP read_rc 0
BUG68_STEP value_equal_rc 0
BUG68_STEP second_write_rc 0
